title: Synthetic Injectable Biomaterials for Alveolar Bone Regeneration in Animal and Human Studies
authors: Tomas M, Čandrlić M, Juzbašić M, Ivanišević Z, Matijević N, Včev A, Cvijanović Peloza O, Matijević M, Perić Kačarević Ž. Materials (Basel). 2021 May;14(11):2858. doi: 10.3390/ma14112858.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “that will contribute to a better understanding of the benefits of this type of biomaterials and their role in bone regeneration” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
